'''False Magma Caps''' are an [[Monsters|enemy]] found in the [[Volcano Dungeon]]. 

==Behavior==
False Magma Caps disguise themselves as stationary [[Magma Cap]]s, sometimes surprising the player. Their behavior is similar to [[Rock Crab]]s and [[Lava Crab]]s. However, they are not invulnerable while immobile. 

==Strategy==
Although False Magma Caps only move around once the player draws near, they can be differentiated at a distance from normal [[Magma Cap]]s by moving the cursor over them. If the green "+" symbol ([[File:Energy.png|25px]]) indicating a [[Foraging|forageable item]] does not appear, then it is a False Magma Cap.
